'''Gupins''' were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Changeling/Legends|changelings]].

==Biology and appearance==
Their natural form was that of small, winged [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Their shapeshifting abilities were extensive, and they could transform into immense or tiny creatures. However, in order to change shape, a Gupin needed other people to envision the shape it would assume. Through telepathy, the Gupin could read their minds to shape his or her body accordingly.

==History==
Their homeworld was a mystery to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] at large, but Professor [[Mankuskett]] believed their shapeshifting had evolved in response to "extreme environmental stress." A group of them were captured aboard the ''[[Starhunter Dhelba]]'', which crashed on Endor, where the Gupins aboard established a colony in a large volcano in the grasslands near the edge of the [[Desert of Salma/Legends|Desert of Salma]].
